description:
A minimal parent POM that centrally manages versions of official Apache Maven plugins without imposing any plugin configuration.

It locks versions only for plugins supported by the Apache Maven project (groupId:org.apache.maven.plugins), covering:
- Core plugins
- Packaging types/tools plugins
- Reporting plugins
- Other tool plugins

Full list of official plugins: https://maven.apache.org/plugins/.

This approach ensures build reproducibility across projects inheriting this parent, while allowing full flexibility in plugin configuration per project.
